gamma_gamma_check.note: Gamma-Gamma assumes monetary value is independent of frequency; a correlation near 0 supports that. Fitted on customers with at least one repeat transaction.

holdout.baseline: Population-average repeat rate (repeats per exposure week in calibration) times holdout weeks, identical for every customer. Alternative baseline, own history rate scaled to the holdout, is in baseline_individual_rate_mae_customer.

limitations: Customers are mostly trade buyers (wholesale), not households; BG/NBD assumes a constant purchase rate per customer, which seasonal buying violates.
First observed purchase is not always the true first purchase (the ledger starts 2009-12-01), so tenure is understated for existing customers.
CLV is revenue, not profit: the ledger has no cost or margin. Values are GBP revenue per customer over the next 52 weeks, discounted at 10% a year (assumption).
The calibration holdout is one 26-week window that includes the 2011 autumn peak; accuracy elsewhere is not shown.

model.implementation: Own numpy/scipy implementation of Fader, Hardie and Lee (2005) BG/NBD and Fader and Hardie (2013) Gamma-Gamma (maximum likelihood, L-BFGS-B on log-parameters); tested by simulation recovery in tests/test_models.py. The lifetimes package is not used.
model.transaction_definition: One transaction = a customer's distinct purchase day (same-day invoices merged), sale lines only.
